config.formula:
IF(OR(
  FIND("New tools(LT 45days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance JP(LT 45days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance TH(LT 40days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance KR(LT 65days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance TW(LT 60days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance LAA(LT 40days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance SM(LT 115days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},""))
),"L4",
IF(OR(
  FIND("Color challenge(New process Color match LT 45days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Tooling modification(LT 15days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("New component(Critical components)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance CB(CB Report update LT 25 days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance FCM(New FCM part)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("DQTP complex(Test LT more than 45days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("HW change", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},""))
),"L3",
IF(OR(
  FIND("Color hard(New color Color match LT 30days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Package tooling(Need new tool)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Compliance SGS(New part which need Chemical Test Report)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("DQTP normal(Test LT 35days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("SW change", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},""))
),"L2",
IF(OR(
  FIND("Color simple(Existed color Color match LT 20days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("Package change(No need new tool)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},"")),
  FIND("DQTP simple(Test LT 20days)", ARRAYJOIN({fldBzJ8Wdsj7vf47f},""))
),"L1","L0"))))

config.formula:
IF(
  AND({fldBACvGzjhjtvp2s}, {fld65xhUcqGNNMHh5}),
  IF(
    {fld65xhUcqGNNMHh5} < {fldBACvGzjhjtvp2s},
    "Pull in " & DATETIME_DIFF({fldBACvGzjhjtvp2s}, {fld65xhUcqGNNMHh5}, 'days') & " Days",
    IF(
      {fld65xhUcqGNNMHh5} = {fldBACvGzjhjtvp2s},
      "On plan",
      "Delay " & DATETIME_DIFF({fld65xhUcqGNNMHh5}, {fldBACvGzjhjtvp2s}, 'days') & "Days"
    )
  ),
  ""
)

config.formula:
IF(
  {fldqzr19sTuYjbpmG} = 0,
  "⚠️ Task Owner Required",
  IF(
    {fldB8J5RpbSTpmORz} >= {fldqzr19sTuYjbpmG},
    "🟢 Complete",
    IF(
      {fldk4gkMw7jQg2SXv} = BLANK(),
      "⚠️ Start Date Required",
      IF(
        {fld30ugjjB5HD9h1t} = BLANK(),
        "⚠️ Due Date Required",
        IF(
          {fld30ugjjB5HD9h1t} < TODAY(),
          "🔴 Overdue",
          IF(
            {fldk4gkMw7jQg2SXv} <= TODAY(),
            "🟡 In Progress",
            "⚪ Not Started"
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
